mapper.select: select t.id as typeId, t.name as typeName, count(distinct r.movie_id) as cnt from t_movie_type t left join t_movie_type_rel r on r.type_id = t.id group by t.id, t.name order by t.sort_no asc, t.id asc

select t.id as typeId, t.name as typeName, ifnull(sum(m.total_box_office), 0) as amount from t_movie_type t left join t_movie_type_rel r on r.type_id = t.id left join t_movie m on m.id = r.movie_id group by t.id, t.name order by amount desc, t.id asc
